items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: there was a band called the Southern Serenaders, from Tulsa, Oklahoma, and they had a drummer. His name was Ernest Williams.

ctx.x: Ernest Williams. And he was very dap, you know, stayed clean and neat all the time, and he had a good gift of gab. And he aspired to become like a booking agent.

So he had heard about our band, because they all come to Dallas, and you know, sometime we would play a matinee before the night dance, and these cats would come up there and listen to us play. He told us one day, 'I got a job in Tulsa, Oklahoma, a road house, out on the outskirts of Tulsa, Oklahoma.'
